answer:
The basilica that shares the patron saint (Saint Peter) with San Pietro in Ciel d’Oro is **St. Peter’s Basilica in Rome**.  
Its site lies within what is now **Vatican City**.  
Vatican City became an independent sovereign state when the **Lateran Treaty** was signed between the Holy See and the Kingdom of Italy.

| Event | Date | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| Signing of the Lateran Treaty | **11 February 1929** | The treaty created the Vatican City State and granted it full independence. |
| Treaty entered into force | **7 June 1929** | This is the date when Vatican City formally became a sovereign country. |

So, the location of St. Peter’s Basilica became its own country on **11 February 1929** (with the formal start of Vatican City’s statehood on 7 June 1929).
